_help: Camp books, §ED.3 (4 Oct 2026). One per camp, on an altar or shelf by the hearth; the camp sim's only readout. Lines are in the folk's hand, stamped in game time; ink darkens by age (fresh -> brown over age_brown_days). rumour: when an overrun ruin (§CN) is within range_m, the newest line points at it, worded from its smoke state (§CV). Reading copies the rumour into the player's log.

object.placement: altar or shelf by the hearth
object.placement_eh: §EN (5 Oct): a shelf in the camp library, kept by the record-keeper; the altar by the hearth stands only until the camp has a library (the storage rung). Wired by Claude Code 6 Oct: CampBook.place_on, Library.

record_keeper._design: §EN (5 Oct). The fourth face (camps.json sim.specialists.record_keeper): the folk who writes the camp book. Mute like everyone.

memory._design: §EN (5 Oct). The camp's own memory needs no writing: a winter-count hide and a knot cord on the library's other wall, both rendered from the sim like the lines are. Found tomes (tomes.json) stand on the first wall.

pictograms.quiet: a single dot (a year with none of the events; added by Claude Code with the §EN wiring)

rumour.no_smoke: No smoke from the {ruin} for a season.
rumour.thin_smoke: The fire at the {ruin} burns low; nobody goes.
